name: Hip Bridge March
instructions: Lift into a glute bridge with hips fully extended.
Keeping the hips level, lift one foot a few inches off the floor.
Hold briefly, then set it down and lift the other foot.
Alternate like a slow march. Don't let the hips drop or rotate.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Hip Bridge March is a beginner hip-hinge exercise targeting the glutes, performed with just your bodyweight. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
